connector.name: Web Fetcher
connector.registryDescription: Turns any web page into clean Markdown, page metadata and classified links for LLMs.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server-web-fetcher. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the vojtisprime11 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: WEB_FETCHER_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Request timeout in milliseconds (1000-120000). Defaults to 15000.

env.name: WEB_FETCHER_MAX_BYTES
env.description: Maximum bytes downloaded per response. Defaults to 5000000.

env.name: WEB_FETCHER_USER_AGENT
env.description: User-Agent header sent with every request.

env.name: WEB_FETCHER_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS
env.description: Set to true to allow fetching loopback and private network addresses. Disables the SSRF guard.

env.name: WEB_FETCHER_RESPECT_ROBOTS
env.description: Set to true to enforce robots.txt before fetching.
